I'll search for information about this MLE-bench project to understand its structure and purpose.

<function_calls>
<invoke name="browser">
<parameter name="action">search</parameter>
<parameter name="query">MLE-bench Lite</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
<invoke name="read_file">
<parameter name="path">/workspace/mle_bench</parameter>
</invoke>

<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">cd /workspace/mle_bench && find . -type f -name "README*" -o -name "*.md" | head -20</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
<invoke name="read_file">
<parameter name="path">/workspace/mle_bench/README.md</parameter>
</invoke>

Hello! I'm ready to assist you with the MLE-bench project. I can see this is a machine learning engineering benchmark repository. 

Based on the recent commits, I can see that:
- MLE-bench Lite was recently added
- There are grading reports from paper runs
- Competition categories have been added
- The project appears to be actively maintained

How can I help you with this project today?
